_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_no.label: Docket No.
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

respondent_name.label: In Re: Respondent
respondent_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petition_type.label: Petition Type
petition_type.expects: check only if the statement is true

petitioner_info.label: Full legal name, address and email address of Petitioner
petitioner_info.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_relationship.label: Relationship of each Petitioner to Respondent
petitioner_relationship.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

nominee_info.label: Full legal name and address for each nominee
nominee_info.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

respondent_location.label: Full legal name, address and current location of Respondent
respondent_location.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

respondent_age.label: Age of the Respondent
respondent_age.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

nominee_relationship.label: Relationship of each nominee to the Respondent
nominee_relationship.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

persons_to_notify.label: Names and addresses of all persons who must be notified
persons_to_notify.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

emergency_guardian_requested.label: Emergency Guardian Requested
emergency_guardian_requested.expects: check only if the statement is true

emergency_guardian_details.label: Name and address of suggested emergency guardian
emergency_guardian_details.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

guardianship_scope.label: Guardianship Scope
guardianship_scope.expects: check only if the statement is true

guardianship_scope_details.label: Description of why limited/full guardianship is appropriate
guardianship_scope_details.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

respondent_need_description.label: Description of Respondent's alleged need and alternatives considered
respondent_need_description.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

nominee_justification.label: Description of why each nominee should be appointed
nominee_justification.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

respondent_attorney.label: Respondent Attorney
respondent_attorney.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

respondent_attorney_details.label: Name and address of Respondent's attorney
respondent_attorney_details.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

limit_contact_persons.label: Persons with whom Petitioner seeks to limit Respondent's contact
limit_contact_persons.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

respondent_property.label: Statement of Respondent's property and estimated value
respondent_property.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

interpreter_required.label: Interpreter Required
interpreter_required.expects: check only if the statement is true

nominee_bankruptcy.label: Nominee Bankruptcy
nominee_bankruptcy.expects: check only if the statement is true

nominee_conviction.label: Nominee Conviction
nominee_conviction.expects: check only if the statement is true

petition_date.label: Dated
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address
attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required
